author: /root/sizing_locales_b
scope: Full-body faithful translation of the reviewed English gift-guide correction; existing localized body only.

ambiguities.subject: Meow product chart unit labels and measurement type
ambiguities.handling: Disclosed the source-owned ambiguity beside the exact Meow link; instruct contact before sizing. No unit interpretation, product correction or body-versus-garment conclusion was inferred.

translation_choices: Proper product names remain English as supplied; short/long-sleeve descriptive suffixes are localized.
Product examples remain comparison examples, without availability, fiber or sleepwear-compliance certification.
Body-versus-garment measurements, individual selections, uncertainty of delivery estimates and the child sleepwear warning are retained.
limits: Model-authored translation; not a human/native-language certification or an independent review.
Independent language review, source drift guards, public link checks and publication remain root-owned.
CPSC wording is translated from the supplied reviewed English; no independent safety/compliance determination was performed.

version_provenance.only_change: Appended the supplied specific chart-unit clarification to the Meow product-example bullet. All other localized text and all markup/links are byte-identical to revision 1.
version_provenance.source_added_text: This chart's unit labels need clarification. Contact us to confirm the units and whether the figures are body or garment measurements before choosing a size.
version_provenance.localized_added_text: Die Einheitenangaben in dieser Tabelle müssen geklärt werden. Kontaktieren Sie uns vor der Größenwahl, um die Einheiten zu bestätigen und zu klären, ob es sich bei den Zahlen um Körper- oder Kleidungsmaße handelt.
